text:
leo: Hey everyone 

I'm Leo, first day. Using Fedora 38 (work laptop). Trying to get the repo bootstrapped but hitting a few blockers: podman compose fails with socket permission errors and asdf python builds keep complaining about missing native libs (readline/pkg-config). Also ./bootstrap.sh expects direnv and a .envrc but I don't have 1Password access yet. Who do I bug?

nina: welcome Leo! For podman on Fedora check `/run/podman/podman.sock` perms and group membership. Try:

```
sudo usermod -aG podman $USER
newgrp podman
# or log out / back in
ls -l /run/podman/podman.sock
```

We sometimes also install the podman-docker compatibility so compose commands just work: `sudo dnf install -y podman-docker`.

aj: for python builds you usually need the dev toolchain and headers. On Fedora I run:

```
sudo dnf groupinstall -y "Development Tools"
sudo dnf install -y openssl-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel zlib-devel xz-devel readline-devel ncurses-devel pkgconfig
```
after that `asdf install python 3.11.4` should be happier.

leo: I tried adding podman group but still got `permission denied` until I `newgrp podman`. thanks.

kevin: direnv is part of our workflow. Install with `sudo dnf install direnv` and add `eval "$(direnv hook bash)"` to your shell rc. The bootstrap script will look for `.envrc` and run `direnv allow`. If you don't have secrets, copy `env.example` to `.env.local` and create a minimal `.envrc` that loads it.

leo: quick followup on the asdf error: I had installed `readline-devel` but asdf still failed with `readline not found` during build. Any other deps?

aj: try `ncurses-devel` and `pkgconfig` (pkgconfig is often the missing piece). Also make sure you restart the shell after installing libs so the build can find them. If you're building under a custom prefix (brew), set LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS accordingly.

nina: infra note: 1Password/org repo access hasn't been granted yet for new joiners automatically on Fedora images. Please open an onboarding ticket (or @infra-bot will create one if you ping here). We'll provision 1Password and repo access today.

infra-bot: [onboarding] Ticket #ONB-452 created for Leo. infra will grant 1Password and repo access; ETA today.

leo: thanks! Another small thing: VS Code Remote can't see my GPG key from GNOME Keyring for commit signing. Any quick tips?

kevin: on GNOME you'll want `gpgconf --launch gpg-agent` and add something like to your shell rc:

```
export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
export SSH_AUTH_SOCK=$(gpgconf --list-dirs agent-ssh-socket)
```

Also ensure `pinentry-gnome3` is installed so passphrase prompts render correctly. For VS Code Remote you may need to enable the agent forwarding settings. There's a short writeup in the handbook under "git + signing".

leo: that helped. After installing ncurses-devel and pkgconfig I could `asdf install python 3.11.4`.

ella: FYI for compose work: we sometimes alias docker=>podman locally but prefer installing `podman-docker` so CI snapshots are consistent. If you use `podman-compose` don't assume feature parity with docker-compose v2.

leo: last question: what quickchecks should I run before pinging eng for CI permissions?

aj: run `make dev` to spin local services, `make lint`, and `make test-short`. There's also `scripts/dev-check` that validates env vars and basic ports. If those all pass, open a PR and ping your onboarding buddy.

leo: great, thanks everyone. I'll file the infra ticket and add notes to my personal setup doc for future new-hires. Appreciate the quick help!

nina: welcome aboard! ping me if you want to pair through the local stack later.
